title: Kadvi Hawa
desc: A grim tale of farming hardship: Mahua, a farmer, faces suicide pressures. An elderly man, another farmer, and a debt collector strike a dangerous pact to survive.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: A dysfunctional Punjabi family embarks on a cruise, hiding secrets and personal battles, ultimately confronting the truth and rediscovering love and understanding.

title: Turtle
desc: In a drought-struck village in Rajasthan, Ramkaran Choudhary churns the parched earth to extract water while the villagers indulge in a tug of war in desperation as they seek to quench their thirst.

title: Notebook
desc: Kabir, an ex-soldier, becomes a teacher and finds a diary left by Firdaus, a former employee of the school. He follows the writings in the book and soon finds himself falling for the writer.

title: Go Goa Gone
desc: Three slackers face chaos on a zombie-infested island, blending horror and hilarity as they fight the undead with absurd tactics and plenty of dark humor.

title: Saheb Biwi aur Gangster 3
desc: Power, lust, and betrayal define the battle between royals and gangsters in this tale of political ambition and complex personal vendettas.

title: Chup
desc: Arvind probes killings of film critics; suspects murders linked to reviews.

title: Dhadak
desc: Young lovers from different social strata defy family and tradition to be together, leading to a tragic journey that challenges their innocence and emotional resolve.

title: Sharmaji Namkeen
desc: Forced into retirement, Brij Gopal Sharma pursues his culinary dreams, but his new interests face opposition from his family. Watch his journey unfold.

title: Akaash Vani
desc: Akaash and Vani are in love. But her parents force her to marry elsewhere because her sister eloped.

title: The Last Color
desc: 9-year-old Choti wishes to attend school but she faces struggle for daily survival. She befriends a widow who lives a life of abstinence. She later becomes an advocate and fights for societal reforms.

title: Ajab Gazabb Love
desc: Rich Rajveer falls for Madhuri, who despises wealthy men. To win her heart, he and his family pretend to be poor to gain her affection.
